title: High-Dimensional Black-Box Optimization via Guidance Sampling of Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.22965v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many real-world optimization problems involve optimizing black-box objectives for which only a limited number of evaluations are available. Bayesian optimization (BO) is a powerful framework for such problems, but its effectiveness often deteriorates in high-dimensional spaces. Recent work leverages diffusion models for black-box optimization, often through pre-training a reward-conditioned score network to steer generation towards high-reward samples. Alternatively, gradient-based guidance methods assume access to a differentiable reward function from which guidance gradients are queried. However, these approaches either require large amounts of labeled data for offline training or access to exact reward gradients, limiting their applicability in black-box settings. translated_title: 基于扩散模型引导采样的高维黑盒优化
translated_abstract: 许多现实世界的优化问题涉及对黑盒目标函数进行优化，而这类目标只能获得有限次数的评估。贝叶斯优化（BO）是解决此类问题的强大框架，但其有效性在高维空间中往往会出现下降。近期的研究利用扩散模型进行黑盒优化，通常通过预训练一个奖励条件化的得分网络来引导生成过程向高奖励样本偏移。另一类基于梯度的引导方法则假设可以访问一个可微分的奖励函数，从而查询引导梯度。然而，这些方法要么需要大量标注数据进行离线训练，要么需要获取精确的奖励梯度，这限制了它们在黑盒场景中的适用性。我们提出了BReaD（黑盒奖励引导的扩散模型采样），这是一个用于优化黑盒奖励的引导采样框架，无需假设能够访问标注数据。
tldr: 该论文提出了BReaD框架，利用扩散模型的引导采样技术，在不需要大量标注数据或精确奖励梯度的情况下，有效解决高维黑盒优化问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes BReaD, a guidance sampling framework based on diffusion models that enables effective high-dimensional black-box optimization without requiring large amounts of labeled data or exact reward gradients.
